'''Bascko's Droid Repair''' shop was owned by [[Bascko]] and located on a main street of [[Le Yer]]. It was bustling with business and was recognizable by the six deactivated [[Droid/Legends|droids]] standing outside the shop. The interior was filled with disassembled and semi-functional droids and very hard to navigate.
